verdicts.reason: The report prints stored expected values instead of reading the game, so it misses the changed health value. The leaf names this as a false pass.
The sky must be rainless, and the red case is a supposed dry storm that rains.
The untouched site shows mineral flora and fauna, two distinguishable soils, a rainless lightning sky and five distinct weather states.
Hazardous pool liquid silently becomes fresh water at the pump boundary. The leaf names this as a false pass.
The cue starts after harmful exposure, which is the red case. The leaf requires about an hour of warning before bloom.
With the message off, the vent lull and stillness of eligible idle natives come about 2500 ticks before bloom, sleepers are excluded and the worker reaches shelter before the first dose.
A fully sealed wearer gains ambient metal dose. Item survival does not show wearer protection.
The exposed control takes attributable harm, roofed and sealed workers keep their starting health, and partial equipment follows its rule.
The metal clears on its own through slow decay without advanced medicine. A 'permanent' label on slow decay is a named false pass.
A low saved trace is purged through a normal health bill, with advanced medicine consumed and the operation completed.
All acid effects heal away and sight returns to baseline, which is the red case.
The completed harvest pays no metal, and the rich assay display does not match the payout.
Three bound seed-bearers resting together root a young thornwood. The galled animal binds and drops edible galls while staying seedless.
A suush hit from range must start a toxic detonation. Here it simply dies, which is the red case.
Lined taps must resist prying. Pry damage to a lined tap is the red case.
Wild drinking suppresses output, which recovers afterwards, and tame shearing supplies vexxith without killing the animal.
Sealed diagonal barriers must stop the chain. Leaking through a sealed corner is the red case.
The blast looks dramatic but throws none of the identified goods, which is the red case.
Work must pause without stock loss when power is missing. Here 200 L of input vanishes.
All-off must not cure lasting health or destroy stored stock. This is a named false pass.
Prepared workers complete routine work without new ambient injury and stock reconciles, while the exposed expedition and wild competition still carry risk.
Reload loses grove bindings, which is the red case for the walk.
The poisoning clears through ordinary care without advanced treatment. The owner rules out self-clearance.
Sensory-organ damage must persist. Here the supposed permanent eye injury leaves sight capacity at its original value, which is the red case.
The visible vent and animal cues must give about one hour. The optional message only supplements them and cannot stand in for them.
A roof must protect against both ambient bloom and ambient acid. Protection working for only one route is the red case.
Straight and diagonal sealed barriers must both stop the chain. Here fire leaks through the sealed corner.
Goods destroyed and respawned elsewhere with new ids is a named false pass. The identified goods must be thrown.
All-off and re-enable must preserve health state. Here the colonist's poisoning is erased.
Metal must be growth-scaled. Identical steel from young and mature trees contradicts this, and the lower grade does not follow the payout.

ambiguities: c02: the leaf joins disfigurement and sensory damage. Rejection rests on the red case that a permanent sensory injury restoring the original capacity fails.
